name: vikunja
description: Vikunja task manager in Claude Code: projects, tasks, labels, comments and kanban through the Vikunja MCP server (@0xk3vin/vikunja-mcp), plus a skill that keeps one Vikunja project as the authoritative task list and a markdown checklist as its documentation.

url.title: Vikunja URL
url.description: Base URL of your Vikunja instance without /api/v1, e.g. https://vikunja.example.org

api_token.title: API token
api_token.description: Vikunja API token (Settings → API Tokens) with projects, tasks and labels permissions. Stored in the secure credential store.

project.title: Default project
project.description: Title of the Vikunja project the skill works in, e.g. Infra. Leave empty to be asked each time.
